final_recent_three_comparison: 067, 068 and 069 all open with a statute link, and 067 and 068 open with the statute name itself. This article opens with the driver's duty as subject, and the citation follows in parentheses. Its first paragraph is two sentences and states a negative fact (no seconds threshold) that answers the title's premise, not an eligibility or enforceability rule. Their headings are topical noun phrases (「向哪裡申請、調解成立的效力」「請求權時效」「證據」「參考的官方資料」). This article's headings are claims tied to its own issue: 「車輪跨線以後，還要看兩車怎麼移動」「為了繞過前方事故，仍須禮讓」「直行車有沒有時間避開，要回到影像順序」. All three end the same way: a document request, the named lawyer's email and address, a bulleted official-source list, and 確認日. This article ends with evidence-preservation advice followed by one consultation sentence linking only /zh-hant/contact. It names no lawyer, has no address block, and has no separate source list because citations sit beside their claims. The structure does not reuse their template.
existing_four_traffic_comparison: 003 is a 20-question Q&A covering the whole accident process (scene, damages, insurance, criminal liability). It does not address the lane-change signal and yield duty or side-rear contact. 012 covers overtaking under §101 within the same lane and returning to the original path. This article covers a lane change under 98(1)(6) and 109(2)(2), a different rule, and opens on signal timing, not overtaking judgment. 050 covers police records and online applications and includes leaving-Taiwan arrangements. This article has no records-procedure or cross-border content. 051 is a left-turn car versus straight motorcycle case, with 70/60/50% apportionments in the title and body. This article uses the turning-motorcycle case 3532 only as a labelled contrast about video sequence and reaction time. It presents 381's 30% as that case's result only and puts no percentages in the title or headings. None of the four duplicates this topic.

substantive_review.actual_scope: I reviewed only the supplied text: the frontmatter, every body sentence, and the zh-hant diagram copy. I checked them against the supplied official excerpts of 道路交通安全規則第98、99、109條 and 民法第217條, and the supplied full texts of 114年度板小字第381號 and 第3532號. I did not open any URL, image, or video. I did not see the titles and headings of the four existing traffic articles, so I could not check for duplication against them. The article holds up on the main legal points. Modality matches the sources: 應 for the 98/109 duties and 得 for 217. It does not invent a seconds threshold, does not set a lane-change completion test, and does not apply a fixed fault ratio. It keeps duty separate from fault allocation. It frames 3532 as a turning/diagonal-entry case, gives no 1-second legal standard, and does not mention the 19,650→13,881 parts-depreciation reduction. It contains no bold, no claim of human review, and no cross-border framing. The consultation inputs are optional and the only link is /zh-hant/contact. Revision is still required for six reasons: (1) the source note says neither case's court-reviewed video was viewed, but 381 involved no video review; (2) the 30% sentence is unclear, and it does not say plainly that the ratio is case-specific; (3) the 381 paragraph does not say that the court made no finding on whether the defendant signaled, which is the article's title question; (4) '車尾被撞' in the title widens the scope toward rear-end collisions, but the body and the case concern the side-rear body; (5) the evidence advice uses 應, which reads as a legal duty; (6) several sentences are clipped or awkward. I made no change to the diagram copy. Its alt text, legend, caption, stages, and the mandatory assumption are hypothetical and concrete, and none presents itself as the actual case: there is no obstacle, contact, injury, damage, fault percentage, measured speed, or legal distance. The legend states that A and B are not the parties. The assumption is preserved character for character. The slug, file, path, diagram id, and diagram_after heading are unchanged.

findings.before: 兩案的引用均依判決文字，未直接檢視法院勘驗的原始影像，也未確認判決是否確定。
findings.problem: This is a factual mismatch. Only 3532 records a court review of video. In 381 the court relied on the defendant's police statement and the review board opinion, so the sentence suggests 381 involved video review.
findings.after: 兩案內容均依判決文字整理；第3532號判決勘驗的原始影像，本文未直接檢視，兩案判決是否已確定也未確認。

findings.before: 這是該案結果，不能依接觸部位套用。
findings.problem: It is unclear what 'this' refers to, and '不能依接觸部位套用' is not natural Chinese. The scope note requires an explicit statement that 30% belongs to this case only and is not a rule for rear-side contact.
findings.after: 這個比例是該案的結果，不是側後方碰撞的固定比例。
findings.meaning_preserved: 30% is the court's discretionary reduction in 381. It is not a general apportionment rule for this contact position.

findings.before: 已打燈、必須換道所以無責任，是被告的抗辯。法院認定其未禮讓及注意安全距離，換道需求也不免除義務；並採覆議會主、次因意見，認直行駕駛未注意車前狀況，減輕賠償30%。
findings.problem: The fragment that opens as the sentence's subject is clipped. The title asks about signaling, but the paragraph never says that the 理由要領 contains no finding on whether the defendant signaled. '採覆議會主、次因意見' overstates the court's reasoning: the court said the opinion was consistent, then decided contributory fault 綜合雙方過失情節及相關事證. '未禮讓及注意' can be read ambiguously.
findings.after: 被告抗辯必須換道才能前進，且已打方向燈，所以沒有肇事責任；這是被告的主張，判決理由並未另外認定被告是否打燈。法院認為，被告變換車道時未讓左側直行車先行、未注意安全距離，即有過失，換道的需要也不免除這項義務。判決提到的新北市車輛行車事故鑑定覆議會意見，以被告為肇事主因、直行駕駛未注意車前狀況為肇事次因；法院綜合雙方過失情節，將被告的賠償責任酌減30%。
findings.meaning_preserved: Signaling and necessity remain defendant arguments. The court's yield and safe-distance holding stands, as does the holding that the need to change lanes does not waive the duty. The review board's 主因/次因 opinion, the 30% reduction, and the straight driver's failure to watch ahead are kept. No amounts are added.

---

汽車駕駛人應在變換車道前顯示欲變換方向的方向燈，並持續顯示至變換車道完成（[道路交通安全規則第109條第2項第2款](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?flno=109&pcode=K0040013)）。條文沒有規定打燈幾秒後就能直接切入。

汽車在同向二車道以上的道路行駛，應遵守標誌、標線；計算車道數時，不含車種專用車道、機車優先道及慢車道。在此範圍內變換車道，即使已打方向燈，仍應讓直行車先行，並注意安全距離，這是[第98條第1項第6款](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?flno=98&pcode=K0040013)的要求。

機車另須依[第99條第1項](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?flno=99&pcode=K0040013)先遵守標誌、標線；無標誌或標線時，依該項各款行駛，其中第3款也要求變換車道時讓直行車先行並注意安全距離。下方示意僅有兩輛小客車。

## 車輪跨線以後，還要看兩車怎麼移動

側後方的碰撞痕跡可以協助核對接觸位置，卻不能單憑這個位置，認定變換車道尚未完成，或反過來認定已完成、只剩後車的責任。還要連同兩車原本的位置、橫向移動過程、接近的時間與距離，以及煞車或閃避的反應一起判斷。

示意中的橙色 A 車由右向左移動，藍綠色 B 車維持左側車道直行，畫面在接觸前停止。車輪跨線、車身橫跨兩車道，是圖中呈現的不同位置；不能只靠其中一格，訂出法律上何時完成變換車道的精確界線，也不能拿動畫停留的時間當成安全等待時間。

實際爭議若是「我早就進入車道，對方才撞上來」，可從連續影像核對：車身何時開始橫移、進入多少、之後是否仍在橫移，以及另一車何時有機會察覺並反應。單張車損照片通常無法交代這些先後關係。

## 為了繞過前方事故，仍須禮讓

臺灣新北地方法院板橋簡易庭2025年12月31日的114年度板小字第381號判決記載，被告於警詢時表示，因前方有事故而向左變換車道，尚未完成時，其左後車身與左方直行車的右前車頭碰撞。被告抗辯必須換道才能前進，且已打方向燈，所以沒有肇事責任；這是被告的主張，判決理由並未另外認定被告是否打燈。法院認為，被告變換車道時未讓左側直行車先行、未注意安全距離，即有過失，換道的需要也不免除這項義務。判決提到的新北市車輛行車事故鑑定覆議會意見，以被告為肇事主因、直行駕駛未注意車前狀況為肇事次因；法院綜合雙方過失情節，將被告的賠償責任酌減30%。這個比例是該案的結果，不是側後方碰撞的固定比例。[判決原文](https://data.judicial.gov.tw/opendl/JDocFile/PCEV/114%2C%E6%9D%BF%E5%B0%8F%2C381%2C20251231%2C1.pdf)

駕駛人負有哪項行車義務，與損害賠償最後如何分擔，是不同問題。依[民法第217條第1項](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?flno=217&pcode=B0000001)，被害人對損害的發生或擴大也有過失時，法院得減輕賠償金額，或免除之。因此，直行車有優先通行的地位，不等於在每件事故中都沒有過失；也不能只因事故發生，就推定直行駕駛一定能避免。

## 直行車有沒有時間避開，要回到影像順序

同庭2026年1月9日的114年度板小字第3532號判決，處理的是機車從巷口左轉、經對向車道斜切後向右靠近直行汽車的事故，適用第99條第2項及第102條第1項第7款，並非一般同向變換車道案件。法院勘驗影像，認汽車始終直行，機車最後靠近至碰撞僅一秒，汽車無法立即閃避；騎士指稱超速、事故時駕照已遭吊銷等，也未獲證實，法院認汽車無肇事因素。[判決原文](https://judgment.judicial.gov.tw/FJUD/printData.aspx?id=PCEV,114,%E6%9D%BF%E5%B0%8F,3532,20260109,1)

這裡的一秒是該案影像中的具體經過，不是直行車免責的法定門檻。兩案內容均依判決文字整理；第3532號判決勘驗的原始影像，本文未直接檢視，兩案判決是否已確定也未確認。

調解或訴訟中若要主張對方來得及減速，宜把這項主張對應到影像中可辨識的距離、持續時間與車輛動作；若認為自己已完成變換車道，也宜保留橫移前後的連續片段。原始檔另行保存，提出說明時標出時間點，方便對方與法院核對同一段經過。只留下碰撞瞬間，往往也把判斷反應餘裕所需的前段畫面刪掉了。

如需就事故[諮詢律師](/zh-hant/contact)，可先整理事故地點、時間、是否有人受傷、警方處理資料、保險往來，以及目前是否已進入調解或訴訟。

resolved_findings: Title now reads 「打了方向燈、車身後側被撞，就沒有責任嗎？」. It matches the left-rear body contact in case 381 and no longer points readers toward rear-end following-distance (追撞) cases. Slug and lane-change scope are unchanged.

Summary changed from 「車身後側或側後方」 to 「車身後側」. This removes a synonym only. The caveat that contact position alone cannot decide liability is preserved, and the summary keeps 應 for the signal duty and 須 for yield and safe distance, so it is no broader than the body.

The 109(2)(2) citation now sits in parentheses directly after the signal duty it supports. 「條文沒有規定打燈幾秒後就能直接切入」 is a separate sentence and invents no seconds threshold. The article opens with the driver's duty, not a statute name.

First mention of 381 uses the full court name 臺灣新北地方法院板橋簡易庭 and the correct date 2025年12月31日. The police statement is attributed as 「被告於警詢時表示」. The other car is identified as 左方直行車, and the contact is the defendant's 左後車身 against its 右前車頭. All match the PDF.

Case 381 facts and arguments are now separate from the holdings, in two paragraphs. Necessity and signaling are labelled as the defendant's 主張. 「判決理由並未另外認定被告是否打燈」 is accurate: the 理由要領 contains no finding on signaling.

The holdings paragraph tracks the judgment. It states the 98(1)(6) yield and safe-distance negligence and that the need to change lanes does not waive the duty. It attributes the 主因/次因 opinion to the 覆議會 as cited in the judgment, and says the court itself 綜合雙方過失情節 to reduce by 30%. It no longer says the court 'adopted' the board opinion.
The 30% is now explicitly limited to that case: 「這個比例是該案的結果，不是側後方碰撞的固定比例」. No amounts are introduced.

「應先遵守哪項行車義務」 became 「駕駛人負有哪項行車義務」. This removes the false ordering of duties and keeps the duty-versus-allocation distinction. 217(1) is stated with 得減輕…或免除之, the straight driver is not called universally faultless, and the opposite presumption (that the straight driver could always have avoided the collision) is also rejected.

Case 3532 is correctly dated 2026年1月9日 and characterized as a turning, diagonal-entry case under 99(2) and 102(1)(7), expressly not an ordinary same-direction lane change. The one second is tied to that case's video and disclaimed as a legal threshold. The rider's overspeed and license assertions are stated as unproven. The 19,650→13,881 parts-depreciation reduction is not mentioned, so it cannot be confused with fault allocation.
The video disclosure now attributes video review only to 3532: 「第3532號判決勘驗的原始影像，本文未直接檢視」. Finality is stated as unverified for both cases, and neither is called 確定判決 or 判例.
Evidence advice now uses 宜 instead of 應, and 「方便」 replaces 「才能」. Practical recommendations are no longer phrased as legal obligations, while the statutory duties elsewhere keep 應.
